text: That evening Gus set a watch on the lamp. Mabel came because the cottage was cold.
Rollo the mouse came for the sandwiches, and said so.
Midnight. One. Two. Mabel slept. Rollo finished the sandwiches.
Three eleven. Gus raised his lantern so the lamp would know he was there.
And far along the cliff path, something was moving. A small light. Swinging, like a lantern.
Gus looked down at his own. Still lit. Still in his hand.
